items.context: george: I'll let Bulmer handle it.

sibling.text: You're going to let Calmer handle it?

items.evidence_note: The independent transcript names Calmer in the same exchange.

items.context: So I… I bring Columber to my side.

sibling.text: I'll bring Convert to my side.

items.evidence_note: The sibling substitutes 'Convert,' but the immediately preceding cue says Calmer is about to intervene and the speaker pulls that character aside.

items.context: Convo's gonna ask for something. You're gonna have to convince him…

sibling.text: Calmer's going to ask for something.

items.evidence_note: This possessive token was missed by the capitalization scanner; the sibling is explicit.

items.context: There, Karlmer formalized the group's new hierarchy…

sibling.text: There, Calmer formalized the group's new hierarchy…

items.evidence_note: The sibling and campaign state both identify Calmer.

items.context: Alright, what about you, Zeph,

sibling.text: All right. What about you, Zephyr?

items.evidence_note: Direct sibling confirmation.

items.context: Barcanar, bearing fine wine, healing potions, and a trust of enchanted goods.

sibling.text: The arrival of Lucius Graeme, a cheerful middleman sent by Barkinar, bearing fine wine, healing potions, and a chest of enchanted goods.

items.evidence_note: The primary split one recap sentence into two cues; the sibling preserves it and names Barkinar.

items.context: Lucius Graeme, a cheerful middleman, sent by Barcadmare.

sibling.text: The arrival of Lucius Graeme, a cheerful middleman sent by Barkinar, bearing fine wine, healing potions, and a chest of enchanted goods.

items.evidence_note: Direct sibling confirmation in the unbroken recap sentence.

items.context: And it was appointed by Barker?

sibling.text: It was appointed by Barkinar.

items.evidence_note: Use a targeted edit because 'barker' is an ordinary English word and the glossary is case-insensitive.

items.context: No, where's Burkina?

sibling.text: Where's Barkinar?

items.evidence_note: Use a targeted edit to avoid a standing rule that could corrupt the real-world place name Burkina.

items.context: Voracol's searing heat aura denied the creatures their regeneration…

sibling.text: Vorokal's searing heat aura denied the creatures their regeneration…

items.evidence_note: The sibling has a different known wrong-form, Vorokal; the approved campaign spelling is Vurakhal.

items.context: The party recruited Vorokal, a fire salamander…

sibling.text: The party recruited Vorokal, a fire salamander…

items.evidence_note: Both transcriptions repeat this wrong-form; campaign canon and the existing glossary identify Vurakhal.

items.context: Alright, so… What about you, Sequoiah?

sibling.text: All right. So what about you, Sequoia?

items.evidence_note: Direct sibling confirmation.

items.context: Ghoul, Ghoul, the Ghoul, gomez, Xena. You're up.

sibling.text: Zinnia. You're up.

items.evidence_note: The timestamp-aligned sibling clearly calls Zinnia in initiative order.

items.context: After bypassing a chained Albert, they wisely chose to leave alone.

sibling.text: After bypassing a chained Albert, they wisely chose to leave alone.

items.evidence_note: Both ASRs agree on the wrong name. T1-4 area 217 explicitly has a chained owlbear, and the prior session discusses this owlbear repeatedly.

items.context: The party later raided Brother Ulrichsvane's chambers and discovered his ritual texts.

sibling.text: The party later raided Brother Elric's Vane's chambers and discovered his ritual texts…

items.evidence_note: The prior session repeatedly names Brother Eelrich; the current sibling preserves Vane but mangles the first name.

items.context: Oh yeah, and how would the Earth's Temple fix?

sibling.text: Oh, yeah. And how would the Earth Temple fix?

items.evidence_note: Direct sibling confirmation.

items.context: …the Canon Turgeon of Homlet…

sibling.text: …the canon Turjon of Homlet…

items.evidence_note: The T1-4 module spells the village Hommlet. Both transcripts dropped one m.

items.context: …my experiences with the Canon Turgeon of Homlet…

sibling.text: …my experiences with the canon Turjon of Homlet…

items.evidence_note: The module identifies Terjon as chief cleric of Hommlet. The scanner missed this token, but the contextual review caught it.

items.context: Heart, Romag becomes the new head of the Earth Temple. Right? Hartsch becomes his number 2.

sibling.text: Romag becomes the new head of the Earth Temple.

items.evidence_note: The next sentence names Hartsch as Romag's number two. Use a targeted edit because 'heart' is a common lowercase word.

items.context: Yeah, let's keep looking at Bitty.

sibling.text: You're going to keep looking at the time.

items.evidence_note: Likely ASR noise for 'the time'; no prior-session occurrence. Recommend Reject unless Bitty is a real name.

items.context: And Nick's on the wrong Zoom.

sibling.text: And Nick's on the wrong Zoom.

items.evidence_note: Nick appears repeatedly in the prior session and is a real player alias. Approve to add it to the known-name staging file so it stops surfacing.

items.context: Seth? Huh?

sibling.text: South?

items.evidence_note: The party is choosing a direction; use a targeted edit because Seth is also a real personal name.

items.context: Oh, you know who speaks of Bissell? I bet.

sibling.text: Oh, you know who speaks Abyssal?

items.evidence_note: A targeted cue edit will also remove the spurious 'of'; this is not a standing name rule.

items.context: Brundrich. Men in black cloaks, come here and attack Minotaur.

sibling.text: Bandits, men in black cloaks, come here and attack Minotaur.

items.evidence_note: Direct timestamp-aligned sibling evidence; use a targeted edit.

items.context: Why do you not help your brother? Charlotte? She has a new laptop…

sibling.text: Why do you not help your brother? She has a new laptop…

items.evidence_note: The sibling has no word at this point. Recommend Reject unless Charlotte is a real person at the table.

items.context: Christian. I'll mull it over.

sibling.text: Question.

items.evidence_note: The sibling resolves this as the ordinary word 'Question'; use a targeted edit because Christian is a real name.

items.context: The Fire Temple, the Greater Temple has assets… Clepo.

sibling.text: Great temple.

items.evidence_note: The established campaign term is Greater Temple; the sibling hears 'Great temple' in the same cue.

items.context: While this is happening. Fairleman. [twenty-second pause] Well, this is happening…

sibling.text: The sibling has no corresponding utterance during this pause.

items.evidence_note: No prior-session occurrence. Recommend Reject unless Fairleman is a real name.

items.context: The Crimson Guard. Yeah, the Crimson Guard. Do you think they're the right ones to be staffing these rooms?

sibling.text: The Crimson Guard. Yeah, the Crimson Guard.

items.evidence_note: Both transcripts agree. T1-4 has no Crimson Guard faction, so this appears to be campaign-created canon.

items.context: …a new educational system based off of the principles of the chaotic Temple of Fire Earth.

sibling.text: …based off of the principles of the chaotic temple of Earth.

items.evidence_note: Remove the spurious 'Fire' with a targeted phrase edit.

items.context: And it hadn't. Lanquist damage.

sibling.text: And it had 9 points of damage.

items.evidence_note: The targeted correction will rewrite the full cue as 'And it had 9 points of damage.'

items.context: Yeah, he's… he's founded Manuel Lieberman.

sibling.text: Yeah, he's fond of manual labor.

items.evidence_note: The targeted correction will also change 'founded' to 'fond of' in this cue.

items.context: Alright, call Margot needs to roll a sailing throw…

sibling.text: Alright. Calmer needs to roll a saving throw.

items.evidence_note: The targeted correction will rewrite the full cue, including 'saving throw.'

items.context: Who can pick the lock? Sequoia. Nami. I can, yeah, I have thieves' tools.

sibling.text: Sequoia. Nami. I can, yeah.

items.evidence_note: Both ASRs agree, but the turn-taking strongly reads 'Sequoia. Not me.' Use a targeted edit; Discuss if Nami is an actual name.

items.context: What's Cerocliff? It's… the time for class is 14.

sibling.text: What's armor class? Its armor class is 14.

items.evidence_note: The targeted correction will clean the full exchange to 'What's armor class?'

items.context: Okay. Yve. Right. You rolled a 33, right?

sibling.text: Okay. You. All right. You rolled a 33, right?

items.evidence_note: Use a targeted edit because Yve could otherwise be a legitimate personal name.
